targets.temperature: native valid-instant outdoor Celsius; same original source/grid/statistics and qualified local target
targets.solar_proxy: existing qualified Weather_Radiation_Evidence_JSON one-hour mean reported solar proxy W/m2; not POA, PV electricity, true calibrated irradiance or cooling authority
targets.wind: existing complete site-reported one-hour mean scalar wind m/s; raw input is adjacent native instantaneous scalar means averaged; no gust/direction/PV-cooling reinterpretation

source_rule: All eligible original data evaluated by predeclared independent source/quality/grid/lead cohorts; historical assumed readiness and actual acquisition retained separately; never pooled with recorded as-issued evidence

temporal.outer_dates: last ceil(third) of eligible local target dates; no outer tuning
temporal.inner_dates: last ceil(third) of earlier training dates, with earlier fitting on remaining dates
temporal.historical_assumptions: original forecast init+9h and label target-end+2min readiness are explicit counterfactuals; original real acquisition/completion clocks remain retained; not operational as-issued evidence
temporal.recorded_readiness: original forecast and label actual acquisition before cutoff/decision; late query cannot backdate availability

adaptive.decay_selection: earlier inner-date point MAE only; prefer larger half-life on ties
adaptive.origin_decay: exponential age by original target time; only residuals already available at origin
adaptive.fallback: original compatible incumbent value if retained else raw native mean

temperature.scale: sqrt(0.25^2 + nonnegative variance intercept + nonnegative coefficient * (native p90-p10)^2), bounded to20C
temperature.spread_semantics: p90-p10 is a learned predictor, never asserted to be full ensemble variance
temperature.loss: weighted closed-form normal CRPS plus ridge * [(location/6)^2 + (variance_intercept/25)^2 + width_coefficient^2]
temperature.missing_statistics: explicit family refusal; adaptive/empirical/raw remain independently usable

nonnegative.distribution: zero atom plus positive truncated log1p-normal; zero probability clipped to[0.005,0.995] and positive density renormalized consistently
nonnegative.loss: weighted exact zero-atom/positive-density negative log likelihood plus ridge * [intercept^2+(slope-1)^2]
nonnegative.all_zero: unsupported positive component; candidate refused, no certainty manufactured
nonnegative.night_and_calm: explicit zero atom, never an unconstrained Gaussian on physical solar/wind
nonnegative.out_of_domain: candidate refused when reported p10/p90 or point estimate exceeds declared target domain

empirical.baseline: original raw mean; each native-hour window and source target matches its own measured outcome
empirical.floor_semantics: model regularization in declared units, not an inferred sensor resolution
empirical.nonnegative: censor local model quantiles at0; never alter native originals

optimization.selection: earlier inner dates only; larger ridge tie break
optimization.solver: single deterministic L-BFGS-B initialization; no random restart or unbounded search
optimization.cold_inner_selection: largest declared ridge and adaptive half-life when earlier-only inner support or usable predictions are insufficient; frozen before outer dates
optimization.inner_objective: matched interval_score80 for marginal models versus same input; matched MAE for adaptive point; no outer outcomes select hyperparameters

quantiles.native_median: absent stays absent; model median is separately labeled locally generated
quantiles.native_crossing: rejected without sorting or silent repair
quantiles.native_zero_spread: preserved; local scale floors stop division errors or infinite confidence

scores.primary_common_proper_score: interval_score80 when both raw/calibrated bounds exist, otherwise matched empirical benchmark
scores.CRPS: reported only when a full declared distribution exists; never inferred for two native quantiles
scores.availability: corrected-only matched support plus full fallback policy, absent regimes named
scores.weights: equal local target dates, then equal measured targets, then original forecast origins; same observation not independent

paired_date_bootstrap.qualification: descriptive date blocks; not a probability guarantee

limits.partitioning: deterministic target/source-quality/native-grid/lead cohorts if total data exceed10000; every eligible cohort gets a result, not arbitrary truncation
limits.original_package_encoding: lossless gzip with original uncompressed SHA256; byte readback before acknowledgement

method_sources.scope: motivates location/dispersion separation and past-error challengers; these small local variants are not claimed as paper reproductions
